description: Joint Research Centre: drainage datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Joint Research Centre, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Joint Research Centre. Coverage: Joint Research Centre. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drainage; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Gully Erosion based on LUCAS; Gully erosion in the EU; Global patterns of gully occurrence. Formats seen: ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-jrc.
